info.description: Run with the matching local environment. The collection contains no passwords, JWTs, or database credentials. The ownership workflow creates and removes its own example employee.

exec:
pm.test("Status is 201", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201) });
pm.test("Save created employee ID", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.employee._id).to.be.a("string"); pm.environment.set("employeeId", j.employee._id) });

item.name: POST create employee as User B

exec:
pm.test("Status is 201", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201) });
pm.test("Save User B employee ID", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.employee._id).to.be.a("string"); pm.environment.set("employeeBId", j.employee._id) });

pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200) });
pm.test("User A list contains only their new employee", function () { const ids = pm.response.json().employees.map(e => e._id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.environment.get("employeeId")); pm.expect(ids).not.to.include(pm.environment.get("employeeBId")) });

pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200) });
pm.test("Employee belongs to User A", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().employee.user).to.eql(pm.environment.get("userAId")) });

pm.test("Status is 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200) });
pm.test("User B list contains only their new employee", function () { const ids = pm.response.json().employees.map(e => e._id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.environment.get("employeeBId")); pm.expect(ids).not.to.include(pm.environment.get("employeeId")) });
